description: This file defines the InteractionsHTTPHandler class responsible for handling HTTP communication with the Google Interactions API, including creating, retrieving, deleting, and canceling interactions, with support for both synchronous and asynchronous operations.

classes.name: InteractionsHTTPHandler
classes.description: Handles HTTP requests for interactions, including creating, retrieving, deleting, and canceling interactions, with support for async operations and streaming responses.

methods.name: _handle_error
methods.description: Handles exceptions from HTTP requests, converting HTTPStatusError to a custom error class.

methods.name: create_interaction
methods.description: Creates a new interaction, supporting both sync and async modes, with optional streaming.

methods.name: _create_sync_streaming_iterator
methods.description: Creates a synchronous streaming iterator for SSE responses.

methods.name: _create_async_streaming_iterator
methods.description: Creates an asynchronous streaming iterator for SSE responses.

methods.name: get_interaction
methods.description: Retrieves an interaction by ID, supporting sync and async modes.

methods.name: delete_interaction
methods.description: Deletes an interaction by ID, supporting sync and async modes.

methods.name: cancel_interaction
methods.description: Cancels an interaction by ID, supporting sync and async modes.
